description: email.rs COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS=65536 is a private const — backends cannot lower it per-account. A large hostile account with collapseThreads=true allocates up to 65536×Email IDs in-process with no escape valve. Maintenance consequence: production backends must read this source constant to understand memory exposure; no trait method to override it; comment says 'add rate limiting' but provides no mechanism.
title: COLLAPSE_THREADS_MAX_EMAILS not overridable by backend
